department.vision: To deliver competent technocrats and entrepreneur in Mechanical Engineering field to cater ever changing demand of industry and society
mission: M1: To prepare a student with integrative educational experiences that blends fundamentals and problem solving skills.
M2: To Provides opportunities to promote organizational and leadership skill in student through various extra-curricular and co-curricular activity.
M3: To develop alliances with industry and alumni for teaching, learning and placement practices.
M4: Imbibe ethical principles, understanding of human nature, social awareness in students to serve the society and Sustainable development.
M5: Get with program facilities and effective delivery of high quality of education by qualified teachers that ensures lifelong learning.

peos: PEO-1: To provide quality education platform for students seeking professional career advancement and higher studies in mechanical engineering.
PEO-2: To prepare students for technological advancement core Mechanical Engineering field work.
PEO-3: To enable students to develop their technical skills across the mechanical engineering.
PEO-4: To prepare socially, ethically, and environmentally responsible technocrats for nation.
PEO-5: To enhance communication skills, management skills and ability to work in a team with problem solving approach.
psos: PSO1: The mechanical engineering diploma students acquire technical and managerial skill and software skills that make them and employable technocrat in industries.
PSO2: The mechanical engineering diploma students acquire theoretical background of each course that they are capable of applying it for solving real time problems.
